workspace cli/find@0.2.6 metadata contract
cases.expected_stdout_text:
Usage: find [PATH...] [EXPRESSION]
      --help      display this help and exit
      --version   display version and exit
Predicates include names, portable kinds, size, a/c/m times, newerXY, access checks, -used, -xtype, depth controls, actions, and boolean operators.
-size rounds up in b/c/w/k/M/G units (default b); K is a project alias for k.
Time arguments accept finite decimal, exponent and hexadecimal numbers within signed 64-bit seconds.
Directory names are read only for descent or an evaluated -empty; stat fields precede directory reads and child effects.
Actions execute at their expression position; -delete with -prune requires explicit -depth.
-exec ... + runs completed batches during traversal with a 64 KiB UTF-8 argument budget.
Unavailable size/timestamp metadata is an error, not a nonmatch.
cases.diagnostic_reason: The help contract preserves the Usage heading across command-specific prose; exit status and empty stderr are exact.

cases.source_version: Documented local expression boundary: -exec must be the final action. This is a rejection/nonmutation witness, not a GNU successful -exec/-o compatibility claim.
Controlled helper produces observable child-ok LF through a supported final -exec action; historical case ID retained.
